input.quote: Pursuant to the doctrine of sequential liability, payment from Kubient to Customer shall be made within seven (7) days from Kubient's receipt of payment, regardless of when Customer submits an invoice.
input.rationale: The Agreement grants Kubient no audit, inspection or verification right against Customer and no access to our systems, which matches the preferred position (no audit rights). Impressions are measured by Kubient, so our own verification rights over reporting are a separate commercial ask, not a playbook deviation.
